data.action: 拄剑而立，风雪掠过发梢
data.description: 【史尔特尔 · 雪原独行】暴风雪肆虐的乌萨斯冰原之上，史尔特尔单手拄着燃烧着灼热熔岩的魔剑「莱瓦汀」，滚烫的热浪将周围十步内的积雪尽数汽化。她侧过身迎着刺骨寒风，金红色的眼眸凛冽如霜——「冰雪只会让我更加烦躁。如果敌人就在前方，就快点带我去把他们彻底烧光。」
data.lighting: dim golden dusk over endless snow
data.promptProse: Surtr stands alone in the northern snowfield, one hand planting burning Laevateinn upright as heat melts snow around its tip. Her black cropped turtleneck, red-lined black-and-white jacket, shorts and combat boots retain the combat outfit beneath wind-whipped red hair. The wide low view follows endless snow into dim golden dusk. Sword fire warms her gripping hand and melted patch, while sunset outlines hair against cooler windblown snow shadows.
data.title: 史尔特尔 · 雪原独行
